model_M: Q>=1; m in {0,1,2}; sum m=Q; t=p+tau with tau in [0,1); a in [0,A]; a=0 if m!=2; exact periodic extension.
claim_dependency_convention: Cnn refers to A-RH-HOLE-0013-Cnn in this document.

claims.title: Common-depth energy domination
claims.statement: A finite common-depth block has E_alpha(c)>=E_alpha(0) at the same centers and masses.
claims.quantifier_scope: Every finite real-center block, nonnegative masses, c>=0 and alpha>0.
assumptions: Continuous unit-normalized box; common depth within the block.
cannot_imply: Does not imply Loewner order, nor domination for independently varying depths.
No RH proof, actual-zeta representation or improved unconditional zero proportion.

claims.title: Depth-variance perturbation
claims.statement: The same-center signed operator difference is bounded by sqrt(2 B_* alpha)sinh(alpha A) times the square root of weighted squared depth change; the summed energy cost is at most 2 B_*sinh(2alpha A)sqrt(V_L).
assumptions: Mass per cell at most two; all compared depths lie in [0,A].
cannot_imply: Not an HS-distance bound from arbitrary original depths to zero based only on a small global defect.
No RH proof, actual-zeta representation or improved unconditional zero proportion.

claims.title: Global realification with a hole-dispersion charge
claims.statement: L_alpha^0<=L_alpha+epsilon_alpha(L) and 0<=d_0<=delta+epsilon_1(L), with epsilon as in (8).
claims.quantifier_scope: All periods Q and integers L>=2; lcm partition at fixed shift zero.
assumptions: Model M; good blocks assigned zero depth; bad blocks assigned their mass-weighted mean depth.
Parent localization and signed anchor-depth bound.
cannot_imply: Does not set the hole variance to zero or delete signed cross-boundary terms.
No RH proof, actual-zeta representation or improved unconditional zero proportion.

claims.title: Anchor-independent finite real-model floor
claims.statement: L_alpha^0>=G_alpha(R,s,d_0) with the clipped finite formula (13).
claims.quantifier_scope: Every supplied real model, every integer R>=2 and 1/2<alpha<=1.
assumptions: Model M with every depth zero; positive integer masses; arbitrary real phases.
cannot_imply: No global common-phase conclusion or direct positivity for the original signed complex model.
No RH proof, actual-zeta representation or improved unconditional zero proportion.

claims.title: Period-free depth-coherent exclusion
claims.statement: For bounded depth, s_n->2/3, delta_n->0 and Omega_*=liminf_L limsup_n Omega_(n,L)=0, liminf L_(3/4)>=44/27.
claims.quantifier_scope: Arbitrary-period sequences with the stated ordered limits.
assumptions: C03 and C04; fixed-L limit taken before L and R go to infinity.
cannot_imply: No unrestricted model theorem; the local depth-coherence hypothesis remains unproved in general and is not the parent hole-mass condition.
No RH proof, actual-zeta representation or improved unconditional zero proportion.

claims.title: Positive exact conservative dispersion tolerance
claims.statement: If A<=log 2, s_n->2/3, delta_n->0 and Omega_*<=10^-33, then limsup L_(3/4)<=19/12 is impossible.
claims.quantifier_scope: Same sequence class as C05, allowing small positive limiting depth variance.
cannot_imply: No optimized threshold or interval certification of displayed high-precision decimals.
No RH proof, actual-zeta representation or improved unconditional zero proportion.

claims.title: Exact variable-depth erasure counterexample
claims.quantifier_scope: One exactly specified finite block; analytic Taylor coefficient and all-point remainder.
assumptions: Finite-block mass is six; no mean-one constraint on this isolated block.
cannot_imply: Not a periodic mean-one two-budget counterexample and not proof that depth coherence is necessary for every valid route.
No RH proof, actual-zeta representation or improved unconditional zero proportion.

claims.title: Positive-hole-mass scope example
claims.statement: The parent three-run family has Omega_(k,L)=0 for every k,L, h_(k,L)->1/3 for each fixed L, delta_k->0 and L_(3/4,k)->16/9.
claims.quantifier_scope: Q=6k three-run family, k tending to infinity.
assumptions: 4k simple marks, k vacancies, k pairs at depth log 2; all phases 1/2.
Parent homogeneous-run Fejer/interface estimates for energy limits.
cannot_imply: This illustrates the new general criterion; the particular family and its too-large short energy were already known in the parent.
No RH proof, actual-zeta representation or improved unconditional zero proportion.
